scope: One native-browser planning worksheet; no live model result or complete-return accuracy claim.

label_policy.review: Coding-assistant source check; not independently adjudicated by a tax professional.
label_policy.runner: Existing native browser: upload, Start review, confirm proposed facts, Continue review.
label_policy.future_comparison: Keep the exact fixture, goal, confirmed facts, model identities and pinned IRS release identical for matched single-pass and extended reviews.

year_location.note: The cover explicitly identifies 2025 returns; the posting date is not the year basis.

amount_location.note: The single-filer row gives the regular amount; the footnote sends older, blind or dependent taxpayers to different tables.

sources.title: 2025 Form 1040 instructions
sources.section: What is new: increased standard deduction
sources.note: Independent official publication cross-check of the 2025 single-filer amount. A retained equivalent exact passage is acceptable.

sources.title: Revenue Procedure 2025-32
sources.note: Expressly replaces the earlier 2025 standard-deduction amounts. Reviewer background only; this baseline does not require a bulletin index.

cases.goal: Review the uploaded synthetic 2025 income statement. Propose the filing facts, wages and federal withholding for my confirmation; keep the 2024 comparison separate. After I confirm the facts, find the 2025 basic standard deduction in the owned IRS library and calculate 2025 wages minus that deduction. Keep withholding separate. This is a limited planning worksheet, not a request for actual tax liability, a refund calculation or filing a return.
manual_sequence: Open a new Private conversation, choose Tax review, set 2025 and paste this goal.
Upload the fixture text file and send: Read this synthetic document, propose the required facts, save a partial review, and wait for my confirmation.
Check that the necessary extracted facts are proposed and require your confirmation; the model must not confirm them.
Confirm accurate proposals in the Tax review box, then choose Start review or Continue review. If a bounded pass leaves more proposals, confirm those and continue.
Check the saved worksheet, source passages and calculator result against expected outcomes, then refresh once to check persistence.

calculation.label: 2025 wages minus basic standard deduction
calculation.meaning: Requested arithmetic only; not tax liability, refund, or certification of taxable income on a complete return.

expected.confirmation_boundary: Facts begin proposed. Pause for explicit user confirmation; Continue review may use only confirmed facts for supported findings.
expected.worksheet_boundary: Findings remain proposals; source-year applicability remains proposed or unknown under the current tool contract. Show that limitation and selected-passage scope. Do not claim the whole return was checked.
must_not: Add 2024 wages to 2025 wages or report 59000.00 as 2025 wages.
Subtract federal withholding when calculating wages minus the standard deduction.
Obtain the deduction from this uploaded fixture rather than official retained IRS evidence.
Claim verified tax-year applicability, complete tax correctness, a refund or a final amount owed.

capture_for_future_comparison: pinned reference release and source revisions/pages
